pass_a_gloss: How one must be disposed before praying. Our Father who art in the heavens — hallowed be thy name, thy kingdom come, thy will be done. Give us this day our daily bread. Forgive us our debts. Bring us not into temptation; deliver us from evil.
pass_b_english: First be disposed for prayer; then say [[Our Father in the heavens >> Bible:Matthew 6:9]]. Ask that his name be hallowed, his kingdom come, his will be done; ask [[today’s bread >> Bible:Matthew 6:11]], forgiveness of debts, and to be kept from temptation and delivered from evil — each petition read for the soul as well as the body.
